rust_summary: whether a player has played on the world before, the motd, and a system line not logged (`native_has_played_before`, `native_motd`, `native_broadcast_quiet`).
doc_summary: `native_has_played_before(uuid)` is true when the player's data file is in the open world's `players/data`; `native_motd()` is the server's motd (empty with no server); `native_broadcast_quiet(text)` sends a system line to every player like `broadcast`, without the server's log and without the `broadcast_message` hook. API @API:join_leave_helpers@.
